from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Extracted key facts from one judgment document relevant to administrative law categorization."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    administrative_subject: str | None = Field(description="The administrative body named as the defendant or respondent")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action or core dispute described")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt from the document confirming the subject or cause")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
